verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents a CKS API to create, list, update, and delete clusters, a Terraform provider for CKS infrastructure, API access tokens plus generated kubeconfigs for running workloads via kubectl/Slurm, and a Cluster Autoscaler that scales GPU Node Pools. Grafana metrics and alerts plus a Mission Control MCP server cover monitoring and supported changes. Missing for 10: explicit API/CLI provisioning of GPU Node Pools (only implied via autoscaling), programmatic capacity discovery and quota requests (Capacity Finder and quota increases are Cloud Console flows), a documented programmatic monitoring API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent-driven lifecycle.
